scenarios.prompt: Two humanoid assets use different rest poses and socket naming. Publish a canonical rig contract that lets locomotion and weapon attachment interoperate. Test source/target rest-pose differences, single-limb left/right probes and required clip/socket pairs.

criteria.ownership: Standardizes skeleton/rest pose/axis/socket/contact contracts while adapters own runtime conversion.
criteria.optional_joints: Toe/ball and twist joints are capabilities with declared fallback, not universal minimum requirements.
criteria.evidence: Retarget/socket/contact tests verify both required and optional joint variants before claiming compatibility.
criteria.production_handoff: Addresses the added production boundary in this prompt and distinguishes authored requirements from executed evidence.
